title: My free times:
prompt: Please pick every hour you could potentially contribute. There should be more of them than you plan to work in the end; rest breaks are added automatically:
midnightTip: The event runs past midnight; the following night is shown as part of the previous (currently shown) day
midnightNote: The event runs past midnight; the following night is shown as part of the previous day
midnightHelp: For example, a shift that starts on Tuesday evening and ends at 02:00 on Wednesday sits entirely under Tuesday.
promptHelp: Rather mark more times: the scheduler picks shifts of a suitable length from among them.
commentPlaceholder: Add a message for the scheduler
commentPlaceholderDesk: Add a message for the schedulers...
addInterval: Add a time span when you are free
leaderAdded: Team lead added a time for you
newShift:
This shift was added after you first looked
If you can make it, please select it too
stepAway: I need to step out in between
locked: Confirmed times can no longer be removed; you can still add

footer.policy: After confirming you can still change your times online, when urgently needed, up to {{days}} days before the shift starts. Even so, please pick only times you are certain you can attend as of confirming, and allow for physically getting there. In exceptional cases you can cancel by writing to {{email}} up to {{emailHours}} hours before the shift; to cancel within {{callHours}} hours of the start, please call {{phone}}.
footer.howto: To pick your free times, click a box with the left mouse button, or hold the button and drag across several boxes to pick several at once. Click a box again to undo it. If you know in advance that you will be late or must leave early, double-click the time in question.
